_about: Design foundation (docs/plans/design-foundation.md, decided 2026-10-15, ADR-0045): the shared packages/ui, the console frame, the situation home and briefing mode, the resident app and Find help on the tokens. Later entries override earlier files.
CON-01: apps/web-console/src/ui/nav.ts (workspaces grouped and listed only when the person's actions answer for them, from /me); apps/web-console/src/App.tsx (the frame from @cg/ui); apps/web-console/src/screens/home.tsx (the situation home for dashboard roles, the work home for everyone else)
apps/web-console/test/nav.test.ts, tests/e2e/console.spec.ts (a denied workspace is not listed and its address shows the denial), tests/e2e/console-l3.spec.ts (key counts on home)
CON-04: apps/web-console/src/screens/home.tsx (key counts as tiles with their as-of time and source; /dashboard/counts)
tests/e2e/console-l3.spec.ts (heading and as-of time on home), tools/preview/console-preview.mjs (axe)

packages/ui/test/showcase.spec.ts (briefing mode enlarges the type and hides the navigation; axe), packages/ui/test/theme.test.ts

packages/ui/test/showcase.spec.ts (reflow on the phone project in both themes), tools/preview/console-preview.mjs and public-preview.mjs (overflow check), tests/e2e (phone project)

packages/ui/test/tokens.test.ts (every pair, both themes), packages/ui/test/showcase.spec.ts (axe colour-contrast in both themes)

ACC-10: packages/ui/src/styles/base.css (one 3 px focus ring everywhere, offset; amber on the dark top bar); React Aria components keep focus-visible data attributes
packages/ui/test/showcase.spec.ts (menu, dialog and select opened by keyboard under axe)
